## Read Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)
# 自定义列名清洗函数（仅做合法化处理，保留原始语义）
clean_column_names <- function(df) {
  colnames(df) <- gsub("\\.+", "_", colnames(df))  # 将所有连续的点号替换为下划线
  colnames(df) <- gsub("[[:space:]]+", "_", colnames(df))  # 空格转下划线
  colnames(df) <- gsub("[^[:alnum:]_]", "", colnames(df))  # 移除非字母数字字符
  colnames(df) <- gsub("_+", "_", colnames(df))  # 合并连续下划线
  colnames(df) <- tolower(colnames(df))  # 统一为小写
  colnames(df) <- gsub("_$", "", colnames(df))
  return(df)
}
exports_raw <- read_csv("~/Downloads/2021_Exports_HS10_by_Country.csv") %>% 
  clean_column_names()  # 示例处理后列名：
  # month -> month
  # harmonised_system_code -> harmonised_system_code
  # exports_nzd_fob -> exports_nzd_fob

# 进口数据
imports_raw <- read_csv("~/Downloads/2021_Imports_HS10_by_Country.csv") %>% 
  clean_column_names()
exports_cols <- colnames(exports_raw)
imports_cols <- colnames(imports_raw)

# 找出两者中相同的列名
common_cols <- intersect(exports_cols, imports_cols)
exclude_cols <- c("month", "harmonised_system_code", "harmonised_system_description", "country")

# 找出两者中相同的列名（排除不需要添加前缀的列）
common_cols <- setdiff(intersect(exports_cols, imports_cols), exclude_cols)
# 对于相同的列名，分别添加 exports_ 和 imports_ 前缀
exports_raw <- exports_raw %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("exports_", .), common_cols)

imports_raw <- imports_raw %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("imports_", .), common_cols)
# 合并数据集 ------------------------------------------------
full_data <- full_join(
  exports_raw,
  imports_raw,
  by = c("month", "harmonised_system_code","harmonised_system_description","country")
) %>% 
  mutate(
    # 转换月份格式：202101 -> 2021-01-01
    date = ymd(paste0(as.character(month), "01")),
    # 生成HS层级
    hs2 = substr(harmonised_system_code, 1, 2),
    hs4 = substr(harmonised_system_code, 1, 4),
    hs6 = substr(harmonised_system_code, 1, 6),
  ) %>% 
  replace_na(list(
    exports_nzd_fob = 0, reexports_nzd_fob = 0,
    imports_nzd_cif = 0, imports_nzd_vfd = 0
  ))
```

# Overview
## monthly trends

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
monthly_summary <- full_data %>%
  group_by(month = date) %>%
  summarise(
    total_export = sum(total_exports_nzd_fob,na.rm = TRUE),
    total_import = sum(imports_nzd_cif,na.rm = TRUE),
    net_export = total_export - total_import,
    total_export_qty = sum(total_exports_qty,na.rm = TRUE),
    total_import_qty = sum(imports_qty,na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# 可视化输出
plot_ly(monthly_summary) %>%
  add_lines(x = ~month, y = ~total_export, name = "Total Exports") %>%
  add_lines(x = ~month, y = ~total_import, name = "Total Imports") %>%
  add_bars(x = ~month, y = ~net_export, name = "Net Export",
           marker = list(color = ~ifelse(net_export >=0, 'green', 'red'))) %>%
  layout(title = "Monthly Trade Balance",
         yaxis = list(title = "NZD"))
```

## Import data vfd and cif values
```{r}
# 可视化 `vfd`（关税价值） 和 `cif`（成本、保险和运费价值）
imports_vfd_cif <- full_data %>%
  group_by(month = date) %>%
  summarise(
    total_vfd = sum(imports_nzd_vfd, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_cif = sum(imports_nzd_cif, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# 可视化进出口的关税和cif值
plot_ly(imports_vfd_cif) %>%
  add_lines(x = ~month, y = ~total_vfd, name = "Total VFD (Duty Value)") %>%
  add_lines(x = ~month, y = ~total_cif, name = "Total CIF (Cost, Insurance, Freight)") %>%
  layout(title = "Monthly Imports - VFD and CIF Values",
         yaxis = list(title = "NZD"))
```

## Export and re-export fob

```{r}
# 可视化出口 `fob`（自由装运值） 和再出口 `fob`（自由装运值）
exports_fob_reexports_fob <- full_data %>%
  group_by(month = date) %>%
  summarise(
    total_fob = sum(exports_nzd_fob, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_reexports_fob = sum(reexports_nzd_fob, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# 可视化出口和再出口的fob值
plot_ly(exports_fob_reexports_fob) %>%
  add_lines(x = ~month, y = ~total_fob, name = "Total FOB (Export Value)") %>%
  add_lines(x = ~month, y = ~total_reexports_fob, name = "Total Reexports FOB") %>%
  layout(title = "Monthly Exports and Reexports - FOB Values",
         yaxis = list(title = "NZD"))

```

## Import and export quantity

```{r}
# 可视化出口和进口数量
quantity_summary <- full_data %>%
  group_by(month = date) %>%
  summarise(
    total_export_qty = sum(total_exports_qty, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_import_qty = sum(imports_qty, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# 可视化进出口数量
plot_ly(quantity_summary) %>%
  add_lines(x = ~month, y = ~total_export_qty, name = "Total Export Quantity") %>%
  add_lines(x = ~month, y = ~total_import_qty, name = "Total Import Quantity") %>%
  layout(title = "Monthly Trade Quantities",
         yaxis = list(title = "Quantity"))

```

## Total import and export

```{r}
country_analysis <- full_data %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(
    export = sum(total_exports_qty,na.rm = TRUE),
    import = sum(imports_nzd_cif,na.rm = TRUE),
    trade_volume = export + import,
    balance = export - import
  ) %>%
  mutate(trade_intensity = scales::rescale(trade_volume, to = c(0, 100))) 
plot_ly(country_analysis,
        x = ~balance,
        y = ~trade_volume,
        size = ~trade_volume,
        color = ~country,
        text = ~paste("Country:", country, "<br>Balance:", balance),
        type = 'scatter',
        mode = 'markers') %>%
  layout(title = "Country Trade Profile")
```

## Status Analysis
```{r}
# 4. 异常检测（基于Status字段）
status_analysis <- full_data %>%
  count(exports_status, wt = total_exports_qty) %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n))

# 状态分布图
ggplot(status_analysis, aes(x = exports_status, y = n, fill = exports_status)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(percentage)), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(title = "Data Status Distribution")
```

## Price-Quantity Distribution
```{r}
full_data %>%
  sample_frac(0.01) %>%
  filter(total_exports_qty > 0) %>%
  mutate(price = total_exports_nzd_fob / total_exports_qty) %>%
  plot_ly(x = ~price, y = ~total_exports_qty, 
          color = ~hs2, size = ~price,
          text = ~harmonised_system_description) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(type = "log", title = "单价（对数刻度）"),
    yaxis = list(type = "log", title = "数量（对数刻度）"),
    title = "商品价格-数量分布矩阵"
  )
```

## Commodity price distribution
```{r}
quality_data <- full_data %>%
  filter(total_exports_qty > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    unit_price = total_exports_nzd_fob / total_exports_qty,
    mean_price = mean(unit_price),
    ucl = mean_price + 3*sd(unit_price),
    lcl = mean_price - 3*sd(unit_price)
  )

ggplot(quality_data, aes(x = date, y = unit_price)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = exports_status)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_price), linetype = 2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl), alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Product unit price")
```

## HS4 commodity price volatility coefficient ranking

```{r}
# 按HS4分析价格波动率
hs4_price_volatility <- full_data %>%
  filter(total_exports_qty > 0) %>%
  mutate(unit_price = total_exports_nzd_fob / total_exports_qty) %>%
  group_by(hs4) %>%
  summarise(
    price_sd = sd(unit_price, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv = price_sd / mean(unit_price)
  )

plot_ly(hs4_price_volatility, x = ~cv, y = ~hs4, type = "bar") %>%
  layout(title = "HS4 commodity price volatility coefficient ranking")
```


## HHI

```{r}
# 计算HHI指数（0-10000范围）
hhi <- full_data %>%
  group_by(hs6) %>%
  summarise(export_share = sum(total_exports_nzd_fob) / sum(full_data$total_exports_nzd_fob)) %>%
  mutate(hhi = sum((export_share * 100)^2))

# 生成警示信息
if(sum(hhi$hhi > 2500, na.rm = TRUE)>1) message("⚠️ 市场高度集中（HHI=", hhi$hhi, "），存在垄断风险")
```
